# JIOSI — Intelligent Software Systems & AI Innovation

> JIOSI is the technology company and engineering studio founded by Shivam Shukla, building productivity software platforms (including JIOSI Inbox), production Agentic AI systems, and secure backend architectures.

Shivam Shukla is an AI engineer and backend architect specializing in deterministic systems, agentic workflows, and defensive software engineering. JIOSI delivers intelligent productivity platforms, technical case studies, bespoke agent engineering packages, and curated developer toolkits.

- [Services](https://www.jiosi.online/services): Production Agentic AI engineering packages (Starter Agent Setup, Business Agent Package, Full Agentic System) with transparent pricing and data sovereignty guarantees.

## Featured Engineering Projects

- [JIOSI Inbox](https://www.jiosi.online/products/inbox): High-performance AI email platform built with Spring Boot 3.3.5 and React 18, featuring AI summaries, rapid message actions, and multi-tenant workspace isolation.
- [Shivsastra](https://www.jiosi.online/projects/shivsastra): Full-stack digital platform built with Next.js App Router, Supabase PostgreSQL with Row-Level Security, Razorpay webhook HMAC verification, and a sandboxed AI assistant.
- [Yojna Setu](https://www.jiosi.online/projects/yojna-setu): Multilingual WhatsApp AI agent + deterministic rules engine evaluating eligibility over 82 welfare schemes.
- [QuickEats](https://www.jiosi.online/projects/quickeats): Real-time food ordering and delivery system engineered with Spring Boot 3, server-side price recalculation, IDOR defenses, and STOMP WebSockets.
